figurative_meaning_en: to be extremely high or reach great heights
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ভবনের উচ্চতা আকাশ ছোঁয়া মনে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: The building's height seems to touch the sky.
history: Inspired by the observation of Himalayan peaks that appear to touch the sky.
note: The idiom draws from natural landscapes, emphasizing elevation in both literal and metaphorical senses.
